background: Nykredit is Denmark's largest mortgage lender, a mutual-owned group that funds Danish residential and commercial mortgages through covered bonds under the Danish balance-principle system, with a commercial and retail bank alongside.
synthesis: Ratings are AA from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A+ from S&P and A1 from Moody's on a positive outlook. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 17.0% is above the peer median, while leverage of 4.5% is in the bottom quarter against 5.5%, as is usual for a mortgage bank funded by covered bonds. Liquidity is very strong, with LCR of 501% and NSFR of 143% both in the top quarter, and NSFR up 10 points since 30 Jun 2025. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A mortgage bank whose model makes its leverage look thin and its liquidity look enormous.
